summary: Outset Medical, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose a Refresh Amendment to its Purchasing Agreement with HCA Management Services. The amendment commits HCA to purchase new Tablo Hemodialysis Systems from 2026 through 2028 for an aggregate contract value of approximately $40 million net of rebates. No price per share or premium is involved as this is a commercial supply agreement. The filing also reiterates prior 2026 guidance. This constitutes a routine commercial contract update, not a special situation. No deal terms applicable.
